title: The Neoclassical Estate
tagline: Palatial symmetry, arched carriage portico, and expansive manicured lawn estate
description: A majestic private country estate in Satna influenced by classical symmetry, classical arched verandas, a grand drive-through carriage porch, and ambient ground spotlighting along lush manicured lawns.
